item.title: Flinker Data Connector for Power BI — Load Complete openBIM Data
item.description:
Data Connector GA

Load complete openBIM data into Power BI

No viewer required. A Power Query connector that reads every property, quantity, material and classification straight into your semantic models. Parses locally inside your Microsoft 365 tenant. No external servers, no uploads.

IFC · BCF · IDS · ifcZIP — more formats coming
